verses.en: For this Melchisedec, king of Salem, priest of the most high God, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings, and blessed him;
verses.pt: Porque este Melquisedeque, rei de Salém, sacerdote do Deus Altíssimo, que saiu ao encontro de Abraão quando este regressava da matança dos reis, e o abençoou,
verses.en_web: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of God Most High, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,
verses.en_bbe: For this Melchizedek, the king of Salem, a priest of the Most High God, who gave Abraham his blessing, meeting him when he came back after putting the kings to death,

verses.en: To whom also Abraham gave a tenth part of all; first being by interpretation King of righteousness, and after that also King of Salem, which is, King of peace;
verses.pt: a quem também Abraão separou o dízimo de tudo (sendo primeiramente, por interpretação do seu nome, rei de justiça, e depois também rei de Salém, que é rei de paz;
verses.en_web: to whom also Abraham divided a tenth part of all (being first, by interpretation, “king of righteousness”, and then also “king of Salem”, which means “king of peace”;
verses.en_bbe: And to whom Abraham gave a tenth part of everything which he had, being first named King of righteousness, and then in addition, King of Salem, that is to say, King of peace;

verses.en: Without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like unto the Son of God; abideth a priest continually.
verses.pt: sem pai, sem mãe, sem genealogia, não tendo princípio de dias nem fim de vida, mas feito semelhante ao Filho de Deus), permanece sacerdote para sempre.
verses.en_web: without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of God), remains a priest continually.
verses.en_bbe: Being without father or mother, or family, having no birth or end to his life, being made like the Son of God, is a priest for ever.

verses.en: Now consider how great this man was, unto whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils.
verses.pt: Considerai, pois, quão grande era este, a quem até o patriarca Abraão deu o dízimo dentre os melhores despojos.
verses.en_web: Now consider how great this man was, to whom even Abraham, the patriarch, gave a tenth out of the best plunder.
verses.en_bbe: Now see how great this man was, to whom our father Abraham gave a tenth part of what he had got in the fight.

verses.en: And verily they that are of the sons of Levi, who receive the office of the priesthood, have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brethren, though they come out of the loins of Abraham:
verses.pt: E os que dentre os filhos de Levi recebem o sacerdócio têm ordem, segundo a lei, de tomar os dízimos do povo, isto é, de seus irmãos, ainda que estes também tenham saído dos lombos de Abraão;
verses.en_web: They indeed of the sons of Levi who receive the priest’s office have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brothers, though these have come out of the body of Abraham,
verses.en_bbe: And it is true that by the law, those of the sons of Levi who have the position of priests may take a tenth part of the people's goods; that is to say, they take it from their brothers though these are the sons of Abraham.

verses.en: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham, and blessed him that had the promises.
verses.pt: mas aquele cuja genealogia não é contada entre eles, tomou dízimos de Abraão, e abençoou ao que tinha as promessas.
verses.en_web: but he whose genealogy is not counted from them has accepted tithes from Abraham, and has blessed him who has the promises.
verses.en_bbe: But this man, who was not of their family, took the tenth from Abraham, and gave a blessing to him to whom God had given his undertaking.

verses.en: And without all contradiction the less is blessed of the better.
verses.pt: Ora, sem contradição alguma, o menor é abençoado pelo maior.
verses.en_web: But without any dispute the lesser is blessed by the greater.
verses.en_bbe: But there is no doubt that the less gets his blessing from the greater.

verses.en: And here men that die receive tithes; but there he receiveth them, of whom it is witnessed that he liveth.
verses.pt: E aqui certamente recebem dízimos homens que morrem; ali, porém, os recebe aquele de quem se testifica que vive.
verses.en_web: Here people who die receive tithes, but there one receives tithes of whom it is testified that he lives.
verses.en_bbe: Now at the present time, men over whom death has power take the tenth; but then it was taken by one of whom it is witnessed that he is living.

verses.en: And as I may so say, Levi also, who receiveth tithes, payed tithes in Abraham.
verses.pt: E, por assim dizer, por meio de Abraão, até Levi, que recebe dízimos, pagou dízimos,
verses.en_web: We can say that through Abraham even Levi, who receives tithes, has paid tithes,
verses.en_bbe: And we may say that in Abraham, even Levi, who has a right to take the tenth part, gave it;

verses.en: For he was yet in the loins of his father, when Melchisedec met him.
verses.pt: porquanto ele estava ainda nos lombos de seu pai quando Melquisedeque saiu ao encontro deste.
verses.en_web: for he was yet in the body of his father when Melchizedek met him.
verses.en_bbe: Because he was still in his father's body when Melchizedek came to him.

verses.en: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, (for under it the people received the law,) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melchisedec, and not be called after the order of Aaron?
verses.pt: De sorte que, se a perfeição fosse pelo sacerdócio levítico (pois sob este o povo recebeu a lei), que necessidade havia ainda de que outro sacerdote se levantasse, segundo a ordem de Melquisedeque, e que não fosse contado segundo a ordem de Arão?
verses.en_web: Now if there were perfection through the Levitical priesthood (for under it the people have received the law), what further need was there for another priest to arise after the order of Melchizedek, and not be called after the order of Aaron?
verses.en_bbe: Now if it was possible for things to be made complete through the priests of the house of Levi (for the law was given to the people in connection with them), what need was there for another priest who was of the order of Melchizedek and not of the order of Aaron?

verses.en: For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law.
verses.pt: Pois, mudando-se o sacerdócio, necessariamente se faz também mudança da lei.
verses.en_web: For the priesthood being changed, there is of necessity a change made also in the law.
verses.en_bbe: Because if the priests are changed, it is necessary to make a change in the law.

verses.en: For he of whom these things are spoken pertaineth to another tribe, of which no man gave attendance at the altar.
verses.pt: Porque aquele, de quem estas coisas se dizem, pertence a outra tribo, da qual ninguém ainda serviu ao altar,
verses.en_web: For he of whom these things are said belongs to another tribe, from which no one has officiated at the altar.
verses.en_bbe: For he of whom these things are said comes of another tribe, of which no man has ever made offerings at the altar.

verses.en: For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.
verses.pt: visto ser manifesto que nosso Senhor procedeu de Judá, tribo da qual Moisés nada falou acerca de sacerdotes.
verses.en_web: For it is evident that our Lord has sprung out of Judah, about which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.
verses.en_bbe: Because it is clear that our Lord comes out of Judah, and Moses said nothing about priests from that tribe.

verses.en: And it is yet far more evident: for that after the similitude of Melchisedec there ariseth another priest,
verses.pt: E ainda muito mais manifesto é isto, se à semelhança de Melquisedeque se levanta outro sacerdote,
verses.en_web: This is yet more abundantly evident, if after the likeness of Melchizedek there arises another priest,
verses.en_bbe: And this is even more clear if a second priest has come up who is like Melchizedek,

verses.en: Who is made, not after the law of a carnal commandment, but after the power of an endless life.
verses.pt: que não foi feito conforme a lei de um mandamento carnal, mas segundo o poder duma vida indissolúvel.
verses.en_web: who has been made, not after the law of a fleshly commandment, but after the power of an endless life:
verses.en_bbe: That is to say, not made by a law based on the flesh, but by the power of a life without end:

verses.en: For he testifieth, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
verses.pt: Porque dele assim se testifica: Tu és sacerdote para sempre, segundo a ordem de Melquisedeque.
verses.en_web: for it is testified, “You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.”
verses.en_bbe: For it has been witnessed of him, You are a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.

verses.en: For there is verily a disannulling of the commandment going before for the weakness and unprofitableness thereof.
verses.pt: Pois, com efeito, o mandamento anterior é ab-rogado por causa da sua fraqueza e inutilidade
verses.en_web: For there is an annulling of a foregoing commandment because of its weakness and uselessness
verses.en_bbe: So the law which went before is put on one side, because it was feeble and without profit.

verses.en: For the law made nothing perfect, but the bringing in of a better hope did; by the which we draw nigh unto God.
verses.pt: (pois a lei nenhuma coisa aperfeiçoou), e desta sorte é introduzida uma melhor esperança, pela qual nos aproximamos de Deus.
verses.en_web: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a bringing in of a better hope, through which we draw near to God.
verses.en_bbe: (Because the law made nothing complete), and in its place there is a better hope, through which we come near to God.

verses.en: And inasmuch as not without an oath he was made priest:
verses.pt: E visto como não foi sem prestar juramento (porque, na verdade, aqueles, sem juramento, foram feitos sacerdotes,
verses.en_web: Inasmuch as he was not made priest without the taking of an oath
verses.en_bbe: And as this is not without the taking of an oath

verses.en: (For those priests were made without an oath; but this with an oath by him that said unto him, The Lord sware and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec:)
verses.pt: mas este com juramento daquele que lhe disse: Jurou o Senhor, e não se arrependerá: Tu és sacerdote para sempre),
verses.en_web: (for they indeed have been made priests without an oath), but he with an oath by him that says of him, “The Lord swore and will not change his mind, ‘You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.’”
verses.en_bbe: (For those were made priests without an oath, but this one was made a priest with an oath by him who says of him, The Lord gave his oath, which he will not take back, that you are a priest for ever);

verses.en: By so much was Jesus made a surety of a better testament.
verses.pt: de tanto melhor pacto Jesus foi feito fiador.
verses.en_web: By so much, Jesus has become the collateral of a better covenant.
verses.en_bbe: By so much is it a better agreement which we have through Jesus.

verses.en: And they truly were many priests, because they were not suffered to continue by reason of death:
verses.pt: E, na verdade, aqueles foram feitos sacerdotes em grande número, porque pela morte foram impedidos de permanecer,
verses.en_web: Many, indeed, have been made priests, because they are hindered from continuing by death.
verses.en_bbe: And it is true that there have been a great number of those priests, because death does not let them go on for ever;

verses.en: But this man, because he continueth ever, hath an unchangeable priesthood.
verses.pt: mas este, porque permanece para sempre, tem o seu sacerdócio perpétuo.
verses.en_web: But he, because he lives forever, has his priesthood unchangeable.
verses.en_bbe: But this priest, because his life goes on for ever, is unchanging.

verses.en: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.
verses.pt: Portanto, pode também salvar perfeitamente os que por ele se chegam a Deus, porquanto vive sempre para interceder por eles.
verses.en_web: Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them.
verses.en_bbe: So that he is fully able to be the saviour of all who come to God through him, because he is ever living to make prayer to God for them.

verses.en: For such an high priest became us, who is holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;
verses.pt: Porque nos convinha tal sumo sacerdote, santo, inocente, imaculado, separado dos pecadores, e feito mais sublime que os céus;
verses.en_web: For such a high priest was fitting for us: holy, guiltless, undefiled, separated from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;
verses.en_bbe: It was right for us to have such a high priest, one who is holy and without evil, doing no wrong, having no part with sinners, and made higher than the heavens:

verses.en: Who needeth not daily, as those high priests, to offer up sacrifice, first for his own sins, and then for the people’s: for this he did once, when he offered up himself.
verses.pt: que não necessita, como os sumos sacerdotes, de oferecer cada dia sacrifícios, primeiramente por seus próprios pecados, e depois pelos do povo; porque isto fez ele, uma vez por todas, quando se ofereceu a si mesmo.
verses.en_web: who doesn’t need, like those high priests, to offer up sacrifices daily, first for his own sins, and then for the sins of the people. For he did this once for all, when he offered up himself.
verses.en_bbe: Who has no need to make offerings for sins every day, like those high priests, first for himself, and then for the people; because he did this once and for ever when he made an offering of himself.

verses.en: For the law maketh men high priests which have infirmity; but the word of the oath, which was since the law, maketh the Son, who is consecrated for evermore.
verses.pt: Porque a lei constitui sumos sacerdotes a homens que têm fraquezas, mas a palavra do juramento, que veio depois da lei, constitui ao Filho, para sempre aperfeiçoado.
verses.en_web: For the law appoints men as high priests who have weakness, but the word of the oath which came after the law appoints a Son forever who has been perfected.
verses.en_bbe: The law makes high priests of men who are feeble; but the word of the oath, which was made after the law, gives that position to a Son, in whom all good is for ever complete.
